---
title: Averaging ratios
---

Aim: Explore properties of different averaging methods across relative skill ratios Scope: Demo comparinng each pythagorean mean (arithmetic, geometric, harmonic) to summarise a set of familiar relative skill scores Problem: Relative skill metrics produce a score for each forecaster, but it's not clear how to aggregate these into a single summary, as each ratio itself is a summary of a different composition of forecasts Approach: Using sample Hub data take comparable scoring metrics, summarise with each mean, as simple and close to existing similar demos as possible, with open questions for testing this on more extreme or simulated data
